## 💡 So What?

**Pareto opportunity:**
The top 10% of patients represent 16.1% of spend. Disease management or care coordination targeting this cohort could yield meaningful cost reduction with relatively narrow intervention scope.

**Clinical focus:**
Diagnosis A05.4 is the material cost driver. A targeted prevention or condition management program — educational materials, screening protocols, claim frequency tracking — is the highest-impact clinical lever available.

---

## ✅ Recommended Actions

1. **Segment patients** into utilization tiers (top 1%, 5%, 10%) and pilot targeted interventions (case management, preventive screenings) with the highest tier first.

2. **Focus on A05.4 management** — analyze root causes, develop educational materials, and establish improvement metrics (claim frequency, severity trend, month-over-month cost delta).

3. **Establish dashboards** to monitor cost concentration, anomaly flags, and top diagnoses monthly. Ensure action items are tracked against measurable outcomes.

## ⚠️ Limitations & Risks

| Limitation | Impact | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|
| **Synthetic data** | Patterns may not reflect real distributions | Validate against actual claims before acting |
| **Temporal scope** | Fixed window; seasonal trends not visible | Implement rolling monthly re-analysis |
| **Missing context** | No clinical outcomes, demographics, or provider data | Layer in additional data sources for richer segmentation |
